purpose: Independently evaluate current-frame HP/Mana bar consistency and bounded short temporal confirmation, then their combination.
latency_criterion: Every detected original image must have p95 <=100 ms for four-resource reading after discovery. Acquisition/copy/discovery excluded; first read reported separately.
historical_test_policy: Previously inspected regression partition, not an untouched test of generalization. No original pixels, truth or split changes.
reader_inputs: Pixels, capture timestamp/source and independently supplied capture-session identity only. No case ID, expected values or annotated regions enter inference.
bar_contract: Verify current bar geometry and identity against the current resource panel; unsupported, obscured or competing bars produce unavailable evidence.
Measure a fraction interval with pixel uncertainty, never fabricate exact HP or Mana from bar width.
Read an independently visible, complete current/max caption to obtain a current-frame maximum; never derive max from the exact value being checked, apparent fullness, level or vocation.
Preserve numeric UNKNOWN. A reliable contradiction may veto a KNOWN number, while missing bar/max evidence is explicitly unavailable and cannot corroborate.
Top horizontal Mana fills right-to-left; supported bar families must retain their own geometry and direction.
temporal_contract: Only return a current-frame KNOWN candidate or UNKNOWN; never copy a historical value into current output.
Bootstrap trusted first readings. Confirm changed numeric values with a second matching, strictly later frame within250 ms.
Reject nonmonotonic timestamps; reset on unknown, source/session/size/layout change or long gap.
Combined mode may avoid a confirmation delay only when trusted current bar evidence moves consistently and its independently read maximum is unchanged.
Report the latency and availability cost of confirmation during rapid damage/healing; persistence cannot override a current bar contradiction.
original_evaluation: Autonomous fresh reader/discovery per original and variant. Score the first reading on each unchanged original. Then perform50 timestamp-advancing identical-pixel reads and20 generated outside-panel pixel changes for timing/guard diagnostics only. These are not gameplay sequences or additional accuracy samples.
focused_evaluation: Adversarial unit/integration cases for full/empty/partial/obscured/reversed bars, caption clipping/ambiguity, incorrect digits, stale/out-of-order frames, legitimate damage/healing, jitter, changing values, panel/source/session changes and unknown intervals. Generated diagnostics are reported separately.
promotion_gates: Zero incorrect known values, unsafe accepts on N/A fields, association errors or ambiguous-control accepts on original corpus.
Preserve baseline correct original values; any abstention regression is disclosed and investigated.
All focused safety tests pass and no historical value is returned as current.
Every detected-image p95 and changing-background diagnostic p95 meets100 ms.
Live temporal benefit requires reviewed original native sequences and independent freshness evidence. Static screenshots and generated sequences cannot establish it.
native_sequences_at_start: None found in accessible workspace fixture or work directories; no Tibia process running. User asked asynchronously whether a short native session or recording can be made available.
